desc: 燕麦摩卡暖针织体系，灰泥墙与芦苇草景承载慵懒通勤感
leaf: 女式长款纽扣罗纹针织开衫
name: 长款牛角扣罗纹针织开衫款

shots.intent: 在搜索结果缩略图里一眼赢下点击，交代长款廓形与开襟比例。
用整排牛角扣与 V 领门襟的正面细节讲清做工与穿脱方式。
把开衫放进通勤出街的真实搭配里，让买家完成自我代入。
用整片后背罗纹与落肩垂坠证明版型不挑人、不鼓包。
补一个动态出街瞬间，把慵懒感从墙面场景延伸到城市日常。
用纱线绒感与纽扣走线的微距收口，以可见做工替代口头品质承诺。

style.backgroundSystem: seamless soft white #FFFFFF sweep for the opening packshot, textured plaster white wall #F1EDE7 with a dried pampas vase as the recurring home stage, blurred autumn street bokeh allowed only inside the single on-the-go frame
style.direction: cozy oatmeal long knit cardigan lifestyle commerce
style.iconSystem: none; the set carries no icon language, structure comes from garment lines only
style.lightingSystem: soft warm daylight near 5000K, airy diffused fill, one gentle rib-shadow rake that lets the ribbed relief read, no hard flash, no cool clinical light
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent cozy oatmeal long knit cardigan ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of oatmeal taupe #C7BCAE, plaster white #F1EDE7, mocha horn-button brown #6B4F3A and light denim indigo #5C7A99; soft warm daylight near 5000K with airy diffused fill and one gentle rib-shadow rake; textured plaster wall with a dried pampas vase as the recurring stage, pure white sweep only for the opening packshot, blurred autumn street bokeh only in the single lifestyle frame, no marble, no cool grey studio floors; model always cropped from the chin down, cardigan always worn open over a plain white ribbed tank with light-wash denim; no rendered copy, no icon language; no color palette changes, no mixed garment styling, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting.
noDrift: no face or identity of the model
style.presentationRules: the cardigan is always worn open over a plain white ribbed tank with light-wash denim, model cropped from the chin down in every frame, horn buttons stay mottled brown, hands relaxed never covering the placket
style.surfaceSystem: matte plaster wall, pale stone floor, dried pampas grass in a ceramic urn, warm oak café ledge inside the lifestyle frame only, no marble, no neon props
